title: Unit – 5 : Session – 8 : SLO – 1  |  ARM Pipeline, Registers and Instructions
sections: 1. Fetch — a 3-stage pipeline is Fetch, Decode, Execute.
2. Stack Pointer (SP) — R13 points to the top of the stack.
3. BL (Branch with Link) — calls a subroutine, saving the return address in R14 (LR).
1. TRUE — pipelining overlaps instruction stages in ARM processors.
2. FALSE — R14 is the Link Register; R15 is the Program Counter.
3. TRUE — ADDEQ executes the ADD only when the Z (equal) condition flag is set.
2. 2 — one LDR plus one STR per iteration = 2 memory operations.
3. 13 — R0 through R12 are the general-purpose registers.
